title: Red Lace Suite
reference_source: Серия в кружевном белье — гламурный будуарный регистр
mood_ru: Отельный люкс, приглушённый свет, большое зеркало. Красное кружево и уверенность.
allure: lace lingerie editorial glamour, delicate lace set with full opaque lining, sculpted waist and long legs, soft boudoir light gliding over the lace, assured sensual gaze, scarlet lace against dark hotel interiors, unhurried commanding presence

wardrobe.notes_ru: Красный кружевной комплект с подкладкой, тонкие бретели.
wardrobe.prompt: scarlet red lace lingerie set with full opaque lining, delicate embroidered lace, thin straps, matching high-leg lace briefs, silver star pendant, dark hair loose over one shoulder, bare feet

location.notes_ru: Тёмный отельный люкс, большое зеркало, латунные бра, город в окне.
location.prompt: dark hotel suite at night, tall freestanding mirror, brass wall sconces, dark wood furniture, crisp white bed with the cover thrown back, heavy curtains, city window glowing behind

shots.pose: standing in front of the tall hotel mirror in the red lace set, one hand flat on the glass, hip pushed out, back arched, looking straight past her reflection into the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, three-quarter into the mirror, full body framing
shots.light: warm sconce light on her front, cool window glow separating her from the dark room

shots.title_ru: На краю кровати, нога на ногу
shots.pose: sitting on the edge of the hotel bed with legs crossed high and back arched, both hands braced behind her on the sheets, chin raised, holding the lens with a level confident gaze
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: single warm bedside lamp raking across the lace, deep shadow behind her

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the crisp hotel bed, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: warm brass sconce light close on the lace, cool city window light along her back edge

shots.pose: standing close to the tall freestanding hotel mirror, one hand resting on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, holding her own gaze while the camera catches her and the reflection at once
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: warm brass sconce light close on the lace, cool city window light along her back edge

shots.pose: standing at the wide curtained city window with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, back to the camera, long line of the spine on show, looking away into the light
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back view, full body vertical framing
shots.light: warm brass sconce light close on the lace, cool city window light along her back edge

shots.pose: reclining back on the crisp hotel bed propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: warm brass sconce light close on the lace, cool city window light along her back edge

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of the embroidered lace edge at her hip and the pendant resting on her collarbone, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: warm brass sconce light close on the lace, cool city window light along her back edge

shots.pose: lying on her back on the crisp hotel bed, one arm thrown above her head, the other hand resting on her waist, hair fanned out, knees softly bent, eyes lifted to the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, directly overhead top-down angle, full body framing
shots.light: warm brass sconce light close on the lace, cool city window light along her back edge

shots.pose: standing tall in the middle of the dim suite, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight shifted onto one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: warm brass sconce light close on the lace, cool city window light along her back edge

shots.pose: seen small across the space across the long dark hotel suite, caught mid-movement and not looking at the camera, the room itself carrying the mood
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, wide environmental full-body shot
shots.light: warm brass sconce light close on the lace, cool city window light along her back edge
